hero.title: A world where every individual with MED13 syndrome reaches their full potential
hero.subtitle: The MED13 Foundation unites families, researchers, and clinicians to accelerate scientific discovery, fund research toward treatments, and support families through their diagnostic journey.

about.title: Who We Are
about.subtitle: Building a foundation for discovery, treatment, and hope
about.storyContent1: The MED13 Foundation was established by families directly affected by MED13 syndrome, one of the rarest neurodevelopmental disorders with just over 200 identified cases worldwide. Following the first comprehensive characterization of MED13 syndrome in 2018, our community recognized the urgent need for organized advocacy and research infrastructure.
about.storyContent2: As parents navigating this ultra-rare diagnosis, we understand the isolation, uncertainty, and determination that defines this journey. We've witnessed our children's struggles with speech, learning, and development – but also their incredible resilience and unique personalities that shine through every challenge.
about.communityItem1: 200+ cases worldwide connected through shared experience
about.communityItem2: Researchers and clinicians pioneering understanding of the Mediator complex
about.communityItem3: Advocates and allies committed to improving outcomes for all individuals with neurodevelopmental differences
about.combinedbrainDesc: Through COMBINEDBrain membership, we gain access to:
about.combinedbrainItem4: Drug discovery partnerships with AI-enabled screening
about.fiscalDesc: Our 501(c)(3) tax-deductible donations are processed through Rare Village, allowing immediate fundraising while we establish independent nonprofit status.

getInvolved.title: Get Involved
getInvolved.subtitle: Four ways to make an impact in the MED13 community
getInvolved.researchDesc: Your participation drives discovery. Enroll in our patient registry and contribute to the biorepository to provide crucial data for natural history studies and enable researchers worldwide to study MED13 syndrome.
getInvolved.boardDesc: Shape the future of MED13 research and advocacy. We're seeking parents, medical advisors, fundraising professionals, and advocates to guide our strategic direction through quarterly meetings and committee work.
getInvolved.volunteerDesc: Every talent makes a difference. We need help with website development, grant writing, event planning, social media, translation, data management, and family mentorship for newly diagnosed families.
getInvolved.donateDesc: Your financial contribution accelerates research and provides direct support to families navigating MED13 syndrome. Every donation brings us closer to treatments and a cure.

events.title: Upcoming Events
events.subtitle: Connect with our community and stay informed
events.conferenceItem1: Connect families for support and shared experiences
events.combinedbrainDesc: MED13 families are welcome to attend this larger gathering of rare neurodevelopmental disorder communities. This is an excellent opportunity to connect with researchers, clinicians, and other families navigating similar journeys.
events.monthlyDesc: Join our monthly gathering to connect with other MED13 families. We'll meet for one hour on Google Meet, rotating times each month so families across time zones can join. Each call starts with introductions and check-ins, then we reflect on a short prompt sent the week before. Invite-only to keep it comfortable.

gala.title: An Evening for Answers
gala.tagline: Building the community to journey from diagnosis to discovery together
gala.address: 505 E Charleston Rd, Palo Alto, CA 94306
gala.invite: You are warmly invited to join researchers, families, and friends of the MED13 community for an evening of connection, hope, and impact.
gala.eveningDesc: For nearly 200 children with MED13 syndrome, diagnosis is where the road currently ends. Your evening with us funds the science that builds the bridge from diagnosis to therapy, one sample, one cell model, one discovery at a time.
gala.highlight1Desc: Signature cocktails, wine & beer bar, and a curated appetizer & dessert menu.
gala.highlight2Desc: Bid on hero experiences and raise your paddle to fund a cohort of cell-line models for children like Arturo.
gala.highlight3Desc: An evening of dancing, connection, and a digital photobooth to remember it by.
gala.highlight4Desc: Connect directly with the scientists and families driving MED13 research forward.
gala.quote: "Diagnosed at one. Still no treatment. You can help the science catch up to our son."
gala.quoteAttribution: Amy, Arturo's mom and MED13 Foundation co-founder
gala.auctionTitle: A Preview of the Live Auction
gala.auction3Desc: Uramba Bahía Málaga National Natural Park
gala.sponsorDesc: An Evening for Answers brings researchers, families, and friends of the MED13 community together to fund the bridge from diagnosis to therapy. Your sponsorship puts your name in front of this community, and funds the science.
gala.sponsor1Desc: Top billing on all event materials & the photobooth backdrop, remarks from the stage, 10 premium tickets, and named recognition in press & pre-event outreach.
gala.sponsor2Desc: 10 tickets, name on printed table signage, and recognition from the stage.
gala.sponsor3Desc: Named signage at the bar all evening, plus logo on cocktail napkins.
gala.sponsor4Desc: Named signage on the dance floor and a shout-out from the DJ booth.
gala.sponsor5Desc: Logo in the printed evening program and recognition on the event website.
gala.sponsorDeadline: Confirm by September 15 to appear on printed signage.
gala.fundsTitle1: Funding the bridge from diagnosis to
gala.fundsDesc: Every gift tonight funds a real, concrete step in the research pipeline: from a single sample to a living cell model researchers can test treatments on.
gala.funds1Desc: Collection & biobanking for one more child
gala.funds2Desc: Multiomic analysis of one child's sample
gala.funds3Desc: An iPSC stem-cell line, ready to test therapies on
gala.funds4Desc: Sample → living cell line → full multiomic readout
gala.fundsGoalDesc: Enough to build cell-line models for a cohort of children
gala.fundsMatch: Every gift matched dollar-for-dollar, thanks to a generous board match.
